title: Winter Outpost
description: Thirty days alone in the deep cold. Ration fuel, food, warmth and medicine through a hand-authored blizzard calendar, push out on real-time scavenging runs across six hand-built locations, fight off wolves with flare and spear, and rebuild the outpost upgrade by upgrade — or freeze in the dark before the rescue plane comes.

achievements.title: First Frost
achievements.desc: Survive your first night at the outpost.

achievements.title: Master Scavenger
achievements.desc: Haul 300 units of supplies home from expeditions.

achievements.title: Fortified
achievements.desc: Complete 5 outpost upgrades in a single run.

achievements.title: Deep Larder
achievements.desc: Hold 60 food and 60 fuel at the same time.

achievements.title: Never Cold
achievements.desc: End 10 nights in a row above 70% warmth.

achievements.title: Unscarred
achievements.desc: Reach day 15 without taking a single injury.

achievements.title: Rescue Dawn
achievements.desc: Survive all 30 days and make the extraction.

achievements.title: Bare Bones
achievements.desc: Survive all 30 days with two or fewer outpost upgrades.
